parts.official_mark_scheme_text: State correct unsimplified first two terms of the expansion of $(1+2x)^{-3/2}$, e.g. $1+(-\frac32)(2x)$ — B1. State correct unsimplified term in $x^2$, e.g. $(-\frac32)(-\frac32-1)(2x)^2/2!$ — B1. Obtain sufficient terms of the product of $(2-x)$ and the expansion up to the term in $x^2$ — M1. Obtain final answer $2-7x+18x^2$; do not ISW — A1. [Total: 4]
